uses:
Alaxan is a pain reliever and anti-inflammatory medicine. It is commonly used to treat:                                                        Headache and migraine
Toothache
Muscle pain and joint pain
Menstrual cramps
Fever
Mild to moderate body pain
dosage_info:
Adults: 1 tablet every 6–8 hours after meals
Maximum: Do not exceed 6 tablets per day
Children: Only with medical advice
warnings:
Not recommended for patients with gastric ulcers, kidney disease, or heart disease
Avoid alcohol while taking this medicine
Long-term use may cause stomach bleeding
side_effets:
Stomach pain or discomfort
Nausea or vomiting
Dizziness
Rare: stomach ulcers or kidney problems
availability_sri_lanka:
Widely available in pharmacies
Usually sold without prescription (OTC)

uses:
Bactidol is an antiseptic mouthwash/gargle used for:
Sore throat
Mouth ulcers
Gingivitis (gum infections)
Oral and throat infections
After dental procedures
dosage_info:
Gargle 10–15 ml (undiluted)
Use 2–3 times daily
Do not swallow
warnings:
Not recommended for children under 6 years
Avoid eating or drinking for 30 minutes after use
Do not swallow the solution
side_effets:
Mild burning sensation
Temporary taste disturbance
Rare allergic reactions
availability_sri_lanka:
Available in pharmacies
No prescription required

uses:

Fever
Headache
Runny nose
Nasal congestion
Sneezing
Body aches
dosage_info:

Maximum: 4 tablets per day
warnings:
Causes drowsiness – avoid driving
Not suitable for patients with high blood pressure or glaucoma
Avoid alcohol

uses:
Medicol is used to treat mild to moderate pain and inflammation, including:
Headache and migraine
Toothache
Muscle pain and back pain
Joint pain and arthritis
Menstrual cramps (dysmenorrhea)
Fever
Post-injury pain and swelling
dosage_info:
Adults:200–400 mg every 6–8 hours,Maximum daily dose: 1200 mg (OTC use)(Higher doses only under medical supervision)
Children:Dose is based on body weight,Must be given only with medical advice
Administration:Take after meals to reduce stomach irritation , Swallow with a full glass of water
warnings:
Medicol should be used with caution or avoided in patients with:
 History of gastric ulcers or gastrointestinal bleeding
 Kidney disease
 Heart disease or hypertension
 Asthma triggered by NSAIDs
 Pregnancy (especially third trimester)
Avoid long-term use without medical supervision.
side_effets:
Stomach pain or discomfort
Nausea or vomiting
Heartburn
Dizziness
availability_sri_lanka:
Widely available in pharmacies
Usually sold over the counter (OTC)
